conference: NAMPI Annual (National Association for Medicaid Program Integrity)
source_note: Sponsor page of the official NAMPI 2026 event site (the conference runs on vFairs at nampi2026.vfairs.com; nampi.net is the association site and links to it). The page groups sponsors under tier headings and carries 23 companies, each with a logo tile that opens a modal holding the company name, its own blurb and a Website link - all four fields here come out of those tiles. The event home page at https://nampi2026.vfairs.com/ carries the same tiles in one untiered 'Event Sponsors' block and has 5 MORE companies than the tiered page: Splunk/Cisco, NCCI, Integrity Advantage, Dun & Bradstreet, Inc., Commence. Those 5 are recorded with tier null; they are on the home page and in the event app but appear under no tier heading. The event-app page https://nampi2026.vfairs.com/en/nampi-2026-app carries the identical 28 tiles, which is the cross-check. CAVEATS: (1) the 'Alivia Analyics' tile is misspelled at the source - the company's own blurb and the agenda both read 'Alivia Analytics' - the name is recorded as the list prints it and should be corrected on intake; (2) that tile is the only one of the 28 with no Website link, so its website is null; (3) two tiles have typographically broken URLs, IBM (trailing period) and BerryDunn (space after 'https://'), recorded here in working form; (4) the Health Management Systems, Inc. (HMS) tile's Website link points at gainwelltechnologies.com, which is what the list gives. No booth numbers are published anywhere on the site - the exhibit hall appears only as agenda entries - so every tier value is a sponsor level, never a booth. Event is PAST: it ran August 23-26, 2026 in Portland, OR, and in-person tickets sold out. Fetched 2026-08-25 from the live site; no archive needed.
